text.tspan: # Changelog
# Todo
- jslint-cli - Lint every file argument, as 'node jslint.mjs aa.mjs bb.mjs' now lints 'aa.mjs' a\
nd silently skips 'bb.mjs'.
- jslint - Destructuring - Allow a default on a destructured parameter 'function aa({bb} = {})',\
valid ES2015 but a stop now.
- jslint - Allow a quoted accessor-name 'get "aa"() {}', valid ES2015 but a stop now.
- jslint - Destructuring - Allow catch-variable 'catch ({aa})', valid ES2015 but a stop now.
- jslint - Destructuring - Allow a default in object destructuring-assignment '({aa = bb} = cc)'\
, and a member-target '[aa.cc = bb] = cc', valid but stops now, and then warn a const reassign\
- jslint - Add warning for 'aa.hasOwnProperty(bb)' and 'Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(aa,\
bb)', suggesting 'Object.hasOwn(aa, bb)'.
- jslint - Check the target of a for-of or for-in head without const or let, e.g. 'for (aa + bb \
of cc)'.
- jslint - Relax warning use_open for ternary-operator inside template-literal substitution '${.\
- jslint - Revisit autofix of top-level whitespace, e.g. warning expected_space_a_b on line brea\
k inside closed-form expression, and on line break between an accessor's 'get' and its name.
- jslint-directive - Add new directive 'tab' to support tab-indent.
- jslint-ecma - Add ES2015-feature generators 'function*'.
- jslint - Destructuring - Allow computed property-name 'const {[aa]: bb} = cc', valid ES2015 bu\
t a stop now.
- jslint-ecma - Expand ES2015-feature-support for es-module-export-statement.
- jslint - Add html and css linting back into jslint.
- jslint-ecma - Add ES2015-feature computed property-name '{[aa]: bb}', '{[aa]() {}}', '{get [aa\
]() {}}' in object-literal, and warn a constant key '{["aa"]: bb}'; not yet in destructuring.
- jslint - Allow member-access on a parenthesized binary-expression '(aa + bb).padEnd(cc)' or an\
y ternary, and a call or tagged-template on a parenthesized '||', '&&' or '??', not only '(aa \
+ bb).slice()'.
- jslint - Warn arrow-function 'aa || bb => cc' as a SyntaxError with wrap_subexpression_a_b, no\
t wrap_fart_parameter, and accept the parens it needs, 'aa || ((bb) => cc)'.
- ci - Automate the pull-request and release flow with github-ci waits, each step safe to re-run\
, on remote origin to test or upstream: 'shGithubPrFlow <branch|create|merge|merge_rebase|merg\
e_squash|cleanup|release|publish> <origin|upstream>', and 'shGithubPrFlow all <origin|upstream\
> <pr|release>' to resume the whole flow unattended.
- jstest - Collect each describe's tests from its body's synchronous part, so a jstestIt after a\
n await throws, then report every failed or unfinished test at exit, and exit 1 on any.
- jstest - Fail any describe or jstestIt name not in ASCII order.
- jstest - Add opt-in test filter 'npm_config_mode_test_filter=<regexp>' on '<describe> - <it>'.
- jslint - Revamp cause-based testing on option trace and V8 block coverage, replacing the runti\
me hook and option test_cause.
- jslint - Report: Functions - Copy each signature from its source text, keeping default values.
- jslint - Report: Functions - List block-scoped names, catch-variables and outer names, and mar\
k closure only across functions.
- ci - Bump to node_version 24 to 26.
- jslint-cli - Add cli-option jslint_autofix=filename to autofix whitespace-warnings, and add fu\
nction jslint_phase6_autofix().
- jslint-website - Add button 'Autofix Whitespace' and section 'Report: Autofix'.
- jslint-vscode - Add command 'JSLint - Autofix Whitespace', CTRL+SHIFT+J A.
- jslint - Add beta-warning to jslint_phase5_whitage(), requiring binary-operators at end-of-lin\
e, except dot-operators '.', '?.' and tagged-template backtick, and update function jslint_pha\
se6_autofix() to autofix it.
- jslint - Check escapes in untagged megastrings via \<char_after_escape>.
- jslint-autofix - Warning 'too_long' no longer blocks autofix.
- jslint-ecma - Add ES2018-feature Asynchronous Iteration - for await...of.
- jslint-ecma - Add Exponentiation-assignment-operator '**=' support.
- jslint - bugfix - Re-verify the block-scope and variable-lifecycle engine from v2026.7.30 agai\
nst the spec, fixing labels, '??=' and '||=', redeclared 'var', and destructuring and for-of n\
ames.
- jslint - Update operator binding-powers to match the spec, and merge warnings 'and', 'wrap_con\
dition', 'wrap_unary' into 'wrap_subexpression_a_b'.
- jslint - Move column-fudging into warn_at(); callers pass 0-based column.
- jslint - Remove dead token-property 'free' from parser and whitage.
- jslint - Improve parser to parse jquery.js without stopping - for-init comma, numeric object-k\
ey.
- jslint-cli - Skip dotfiles when linting a directory.
- jslint-ci - Merge ci-shell-function shGithubPrUpdatePrxxx() into shGithubPrCreate().
- jslint - Reviewed probable-deadcode-sections and confirmed 7 of 8 were real-deadcode.
